candidates.snippet: Protests broke out in the Syrian city of Aleppo on Sunday after the government raised fuel and gas prices by between 20 and 40 percent. https://t.co/mf5h7fIJZo

Demonstrations were reported across Syrian cities of Idlib, Hama, Raqqa, Deir al-Zor and Hasakah, with protesters preventing oil tankers from passing in some areas and calling for the energy minister's resignation after the government sharply increased fuel prices
